# Single Mothers Initiative Program (SMIP)

> SMIP is a community-based organisation founded in 2024 that gives emergency relief, psychosocial support, livelihood training and childcare access to single mothers and their children in Uganda, including mothers who fled the war in Sudan.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://singlemothersinitiativeprogram.org/): Mission, programs and how to help
- [The Sudan Crisis](https://singlemothersinitiativeprogram.org/sudan-crisis.html): Why single mothers who fled Sudan need support, with sources
- [Programs](https://singlemothersinitiativeprogram.org/programs.html): Emergency assistance, psychosocial support, economic empowerment, childcare
- [Donate](https://singlemothersinitiativeprogram.org/donate.html): Give by MTN or Airtel Mobile Money via WhatsApp
- [About](https://singlemothersinitiativeprogram.org/about.html): Mission, vision, values and accountability
- [Contact](https://singlemothersinitiativeprogram.org/contact.html): Phone and WhatsApp +256 786 077 561
